result.topic_en: Draft of uniqueness and mean-value arguments for a function u satisfying Riemann's conditions (harmonic functions). If u and du/dp both vanish along a line, u vanishes everywhere; Cauchy data on a line determine u; u has no interior maximum or minimum.

items.english: If the values of u and du/dp along a line are given, then u is thereby determined in all parts of S.

items.english: If u is not constant everywhere, the points in the interior of S where u has a constant value necessarily form lines that separate surface parts where u is positive from surface parts where u is negative.
